newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Monday. Most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's 1500 GMT release of the U.S. October existing homes sales report which is forecast to be around 4.0 million units compared with 4.02 million units reported in September.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. Some people are waiting for more clues to market direction from tonight's release of the existing homes sales figures," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact here unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
